name: tabby-highlight-pane
description: Tabby plugin that highlights the active split pane

scripts.deploy: webpack --mode development && powershell -Command "$target='$env:APPDATA\tabby\plugins\node_modules\tabby-highlight-pane'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $target\dist; Copy-Item dist\* $target\dist\ -Force; Copy-Item package.json $target\ -Force; Write-Host 'Deploy complete'"

author: smhong
